page.content:
Water fay who fosters Lancelot and gives Excalibur.

How Lady of the Lake connects

  • Weapon: Excalibur — The Lady of the Lake gives Excalibur to Arthur.
  • Character: Lancelot — The Lady of the Lake fostered Lancelot.

What is Lady of the Lake?

The Lady of the Lake — Viviane, Nimue, or a sisterhood of fays — raises Lancelot, bestows or reclaims Excalibur, and in some tellings binds Merlin.

Key threads lead to Excalibur and Lancelot.
